claims.text: CV effects unresponsive to benzodiazepines: IV nitrates, nicardipine or alpha-adrenergic antagonists; ⍉BBs
claims.quote: For cardiovascular effects unresponsive to benzodiazepines, IV nitrates, nicardipine , or alpha-adrenergic antagonists (do not use beta blockers)

claims.text: Cocaine CP: BBs contraindicated; benzodiazepines are first-line
claims.quote: For patients with chest pain, as noted, beta-blockers are contraindicated in cocaine toxicity, and benzodiazepines are first-line therapy.

claims.text: Coronary vasodilate needed after benzodiazepines: nitrates
claims.quote: If coronary vasodilation is required after benzodiazepines, nitrates are given

claims.text: AHA statement, cocaine CP/MI: benzodiazepines, nitrates, antiplatelet and antithrombotic therapy, PCI when indicated
claims.quote: Cocaine-associated chest pain/MI Benzodiazepines, nitrates, antiplatelet and antithrombotic therapy, and PCI when indicated
